title: Release
text: “……Next, regarding Motoyasu-dono, while he himself accomplished nothing particularly noteworthy, one of his subordinates apparently worked together with Ren-dono and contributed to the effort, so we shall grant 1,000 silver coins.”
Kuro-chan’s contribution was worth about 400 silver coins, I say! There is far too great a disparity in treatment compared to Ren, indeed!
“Heeey… Shadow Saint-kun…”

I was so irritated that I nearly raised my spear, but it seemed Kuro-chan was eager to go see Ren as soon as possible. I supposed I ought to endure this here. Trash, you should be grateful for my mercy, I say. And when the proper time comes, I shall teach you despair. I shall have Fleon-chan awaken you to justice as well! While I was pondering such future retribution against Trash, some additional paper was brought forward. For some reason, it was handed to Éclair.
“And as for Shield, there is the matter of the disturbance he caused this time, Itsuki-dono’s medical expenses, and furthermore the cost of releasing the Seaetto girl. Hand that to Shield.”
It read a bill for 7,000 silver coins, I say. Just how much are you trying to squeeze out of him, indeed!
“My own crimes aside… Your Majesty, it is not too late even now. I ask that you cease this scheme against Shield Hero-dono. Such an atrocity—the other nations, and the Queen, will never permit it!”
“My wife’s thoughts are my thoughts! Despite this being equivalent to the forfeiture of your title, what is this attitude of yours!”
At this point, Itsuki raised his hand, looking displeased.
“It infuriates me to say it, but it was Naofumi-san who treated my wounds first and foremost, you know? What exactly is this medical expense supposed to be for?”
“Itsuki-sama! Do you mean to take the side of such a vile, vulgar man!?”
Smoked Meat raised his voice in protest at Itsuki’s words.
“Silence, Mald. Even your own thinking has begun to seem suspicious to me. Honestly, I am even considering whether to replace you with Rojiru.”
“What— did you say!? Are you suggesting Rojiru is more correct than I am!?”
Ah, that would be the warrior-looking fellow, Smoked Meat’s runner-up, I suppose. It seemed even Itsuki had begun to harbor some suspicion toward the kingdom.

“I’m not finished speaking. Your Majesty, since I won custody of Eclair-san from Naofumi-san through our duel, to now demand payment for her at this late stage is far too unseemly… Even if emotions run high, one must still keep things logical.”
Itsuki fixed Trash with a sharp glare. Hmm, to think even that Itsuki would end up like this… It felt rather satisfying to see Trash despised from every direction.
“Since Naofumi-san took custody of Eclair-san as his reward for the wave, monetary compensation aside, this reparation demand exceeds all reasonable bounds.”
“Hmm… if Itsuki-dono says so, then indeed, that must be true. I too cannot remain calm when my beloved, kind-hearted daughter has been treated in such a manner.”
Trash offered agreement with not a shred of sincerity in his heart. One could tell at a glance that inwardly he was burning with rage.

“Yes, there is no doubt Naofumi-san’s methods were despicable, but that doesn’t mean it’s acceptable for our side to act without logic either. From now on, Melromarc must cease practices like slave-hunting. That much should be thoroughly enforced.”
“Indeed, if there are those engaging in such acts, they must without question be punished! I shall see to it, on the honor of this kingdom.”

And so Trash made some sort of promise to Itsuki, though it was plain to see it would end up being nothing but empty formality. I could already picture the future: only the slave-hunters unlucky enough to catch Itsuki’s eye would actually be punished.
“That being the case, that paper is unnecessary.”
“Bow Hero-dono… my thanks.”
“It’s fine. But please be careful. If you let your guard down around Naofumi-san even a little, he’ll surely force himself on you.”

Itsuki still apparently believed that whole business about the assault on the Crimson Swine. And yet his reasoning was rather inconsistent. Make sure to properly pay the reward from the duel with Father, and yet refuse to acknowledge Father himself.

Does he think of himself as some paragon of integrity? Undoubtedly he does. There are limits to how foolish one can be, indeed. Perhaps it would be worthwhile to personally pound the truth of this kingdom into him.
“……Well then, the distribution of relief funds for this occasion concludes here. Heroes, each of you continue your training until the next wave. Dismissed!”
Trash blasted out his customary line and declared the meeting dismissed.
“Your Majesty… I have something to say, here and now.”
Éclair raised her hand, apparently intent on addressing Trash as he tried to leave. Futile, I imagined, but still.
“What is it? I am busy. Your title has already been stripped from you—what could you possibly have to say?”

“As I stated earlier, you must cease this unjust treatment of Shield Hero-dono immediately, retract the rumors that have been spread, and inform the citizens of the truth without delay. The world must prepare against the calamity of the waves. Do you not understand that the current Shield Hero-dono bears no guilt whatsoever!”
“That man trampled upon Malty’s mercy! He even attacked her like a beast! This fact remains unshaken!”

Incidentally, it seemed Trash genuinely believed that Father had actually attempted to violate the Crimson Swine. Apparently, in later years, some part of Trash’s heart came to suspect it had all been a lie. To think he believed the Crimson Swine’s nonsense so thoroughly—it left me speechless, indeed. Though I too once committed such a foolish sin.

“As it has not yet been long since I began speaking with him, I cannot claim to fully grasp what sort of man Iwatani-dono truly is, and so I cannot state this with certainty—but someone I trust tells me the truth lies elsewhere. Your Majesty… I put forth once more that the truth ought to be investigated anew.”
And then… Éclair rose to her feet and turned her back.
“I shall settle the matter of my own crimes once the Queen returns. Today I came only to deliver this report. Now then, until the appointed time comes, I shall take my leave.”
“Hmph! Know your place!”

And so Éclair departed. Given this flow of events… perhaps that would be the moment? After beating Trash to a pulp, drag the Crimson Swine out here too, scorch its face, then leave? No… setting aside the trouble it would cause Father, who was carrying out the Filo-tan Plan, doing something so reckless might also mean I’d never get to see Filo-tan again. So I supposed I would hold back, just a little. Crimson Swine, you got to keep your life today. Well, disposing of you would be easy enough anyway.
“Bu-bu-bu.”

Hm? As I was about to leave the castle, following after Éclair, Lazy Pig called out to Itsuki and handed something over. Smoked Meat tried to step in between them, but Itsuki silenced him with an unpleasant look before accepting it. What could she be planning? Surely she wasn’t thinking of switching allegiance from Father to Itsuki. Well, if so, by all means, go right ahead, I say! Perfect timing for disposal. I would be sure to tattle to Father about this later.
“Kuro’s going to go play at Shadow Saint’s place—”
“Off you go, then, indeed. Be sure to come back properly, now.”
Kuro-chan apparently wanted to go play at Ren’s place, so I saw her off.
“Okaaay, I’m off—”
“Actually… I would really rather you didn’t come…”

And so, while seeing Kuro-chan off in that manner, I made my way back with Éclair to the tent where Alligator Man and Rabbit Man were staying. Naturally, some shady characters accosted us along the way, but I silenced them immediately, of course.
“Well now, what shall we do from here? Since Iwatani-sama has given me the day off today, I suppose I am free, if you could call it that.”
Rabbit Man was relaxing inside the tent along with Alligator Man.
“Eclair-sama, welcome back.”

Alligator Man greeted Éclair upon her return. Wolf was waiting restlessly inside his cage. He seemed to have already heard Father’s instructions and accepted that he would not be returning for a few days.
